title: Jurisdiction, Zoning, and Land-Use Intelligence vertical slice
originalPrompt:
Continue LandOS from current main at commit cba457dbe43323fe05e00c5e8751355e2c3425fc.

Implement the next complete three-brain vertical slice:

Jurisdiction, Zoning, and Land-Use Intelligence.

First inspect the repository, current checkpoint, the versioned Property Summary pattern, the government-record risk slice, parcel-resolution flow, evidence and artifact system, Operator jobs and attempts, Analyst boundaries, snapshot persistence, and existing zoning-related code.

Extend the existing architecture rather than creating a parallel system.

Desired operator outcome

For every confirmed subject parcel, LandOS should independently determine:

1. Which government has planning and zoning authority over the exact parcel.
2. Whether the property is incorporated, unincorporated, inside a township, municipality, county jurisdiction, extraterritorial jurisdiction, or other special planning area.
3. The official base zoning district.
4. Any overlay, special-purpose, historic, floodplain, airport, corridor, planned-development, or similar district.
5. The governing zoning ordinance and effective version.
6. Uses permitted by right.
7. Conditional, special-exception, administrative, or discretionary uses.
8. Prohibited or unsupported uses when the ordinance establishes them.
9. Dimensional and development standards, including lot size, frontage, setbacks, density, height, lot coverage, parking, access, subdivision, manufactured housing, accessory uses, and other material standards.
10. Practical development options, material limitations, unanswered questions, and the official evidence supporting each conclusion.

Core rules

Property research is anchored only to the confirmed subject parcel and geometry.

Seller, lead, wholesaler, or owner-name mismatches must never block zoning research.

Do not infer zoning authority from the mailing city, ZIP code, nearest city, county name, or address label.

Determine the actual governing jurisdiction first.

Do not interpret a zoning label such as R-1, AG, M-1, or C-2 until the exact jurisdiction and governing ordinance are confirmed. District labels are not portable between jurisdictions.

Do not treat a third-party zoning label as official confirmation unless independently corroborated by an official planning, zoning, GIS, ordinance, or government source.

Do not claim a use is allowed merely because it is not visibly prohibited. Distinguish:

permitted by right

conditional or special approval

accessory use

prohibited

not located in the reviewed ordinance

uncertain because the controlling provision was unavailable

Do not fabricate zoning, jurisdiction, overlays, permitted uses, dimensional standards, or ordinance citations.

Three-brain boundaries

Operator brain

The Operator owns:

jurisdiction resolution

official zoning-map and ordinance retrieval

browser and API execution

free government login or registration when required

durable jobs and attempts

timeouts, retries, blocked states, restart recovery, and idempotency

raw evidence and artifact retention

source URLs, retrieval dates, ordinance dates, screenshots, PDFs, zoning maps, tables, and government documents

normalized zoning facts

Analyst invocation

versioned snapshot persistence

browser cleanup

Analyst brain

The Analyst receives only normalized, versioned inputs.

It should determine and explain:

confirmed zoning authority

base district and overlays

uses by right

conditional or special uses

material dimensional standards

subdivision and development implications

likely highest-value realistic use paths supported by the current zoning

material conflicts and risks

missing information and precise follow-up questions

confidence, limitations, and evidence references

The Analyst must not browse, call providers, write the database, schedule work, approve corrections, or render UI.

Deal Card

The Deal Card reads the persisted zoning snapshot.

Opening or refreshing the Deal Card must not trigger zoning research, ordinance retrieval, reconciliation, or analysis.

Rebuild must be an explicit Operator command.

Jurisdiction and provider architecture

Use reusable platform and vendor adapters with jurisdiction-specific configuration rather than writing a separate workflow for every county, city, or township.

The intended process is:

confirmed parcel and geometry

determine incorporated or unincorporated status

identify every potentially relevant planning authority

confirm the controlling authority using official evidence

identify the official zoning-map and ordinance platforms

select reusable adapters

apply jurisdiction-specific configuration

retrieve evidence

normalize facts

invoke the Analyst

persist a versioned zoning snapshot

When a platform is unknown or has changed, use adaptive browser inspection where appropriate, then retain the successful navigation pattern for reuse.

Known portals should use deterministic automation.

Free government account creation and login are approved.

Do not purchase reports, records, subscriptions, credits, ordinance access, or government-site document access.

Do not bypass payment systems, CAPTCHAs, authentication controls, or technical access restrictions.

Evidence and artifact retention

Retain official evidence when available, including:

official zoning map result

parcel zoning lookup result

municipal boundary or jurisdiction map

planning department page

official zoning ordinance PDF or HTML

district use table

dimensional standards table

overlay district map and ordinance

special district or planned-development document

relevant board, commission, or adopted ordinance material when it directly controls the parcel

Retain original PDFs, images, or readable page captures when appropriate.

Every normalized zoning fact must link to official evidence and, where possible, the exact page, section, table, or map reference.

Preserve:

source jurisdiction

controlling authority

official source URL

retrieval timestamp

ordinance title

ordinance adoption or effective date

section, article, table, and page references

district and overlay names

artifact hashes

identity version

collector job and attempt

Do not use a screenshot or map color alone as the final zoning conclusion when an official legend, parcel result, or ordinance is needed to interpret it.

Corrections

Zoning and jurisdiction corrections must create new evidence and snapshot versions.

Do not overwrite accepted facts silently.

A confirmed jurisdiction or zoning district correction should record:

prior value

replacement value

supporting evidence

reason

actor

timestamp

approval reference when required

declared downstream invalidations

Changing zoning should invalidate only dependent zoning, valuation, strategy, and development conclusions, not unrelated deed, environmental, seller, or tax evidence.

Required workflow states

Each zoning domain should support:

queued

running

complete

partial

blocked

unavailable

conflicted

superseded

manual review needed

One failed source must not block unrelated research.

Required live proof cases

Implement automated tests and live acceptance that prove:

1. Confirmed parcel in an unincorporated county jurisdiction.
2. Confirmed parcel inside an incorporated municipality.
3. Township-controlled zoning.
4. Mailing city differs from actual zoning authority.
5. County and city sources disagree.
6. Official zoning map confirms the parcel district.
7. Third-party zoning differs from the official source.
8. Base zoning plus an overlay district.
9. Uses permitted by right are extracted with exact ordinance citations.
10. Conditional or special uses remain clearly separated from by-right uses.
11. Dimensional standards are extracted from the correct district table.
12. District label exists but the ordinance could not be retrieved.
13. Official source requires free registration.
14. Official source is blocked, changed, or unavailable.
15. Interrupted collection resumes without duplicate evidence.
16. Identical inputs rebuild idempotently.
17. A zoning correction creates a new version and invalidates only declared dependents.
18. GET and Deal Card loading remain read-only.
19. Browser pages and contexts close after success, failure, timeout, or cancellation.
20. Repeated runs do not steadily increase open browser resources or memory.

Live acceptance

Use at least one real confirmed Deal Card already in LandOS where zoning jurisdiction and official zoning sources can be reached without payment.

Prove the complete flow:

confirmed parcel

jurisdiction determination

official zoning-map retrieval

official ordinance retrieval

district and overlay result

uses by right

conditional uses

material dimensional standards

persisted Analyst result

Deal Card presentation

refresh persistence

managed restart persistence

no duplicate evidence

browser cleanup

Do not fabricate a complete result if an official source is unavailable. Honest partial completion is acceptable when the source-specific limitation is visible.

Presentation

Add a persisted zoning and land-use panel to the existing Deal Card structure.

Keep this operator-focused and readable.

Show:

controlling zoning authority

incorporated or unincorporated status

base district

overlays

official sources

uses by right

conditional or special uses

key dimensional standards

development implications

risks and conflicts

missing evidence

last researched date

snapshot version

Do not redesign the entire Deal Card in this sprint.

Builder verification

Add architecture-boundary and regression tests so:

Analyst modules cannot import browser, route, provider, database, filesystem, or UI modules

collectors cannot make strategy or valuation decisions

GET routes cannot execute live research or write snapshots

UI cannot import collectors or Analyst engines

unconfirmed property identity blocks zoning analysis

zoning labels cannot be interpreted without a confirmed jurisdiction and ordinance source

conditional uses cannot be presented as by-right uses

identical input versions produce idempotent snapshots

Run:

focused tests

full repository tests

server typecheck

frontend typecheck if available

server production build

web production build

database and migration verification

memory audit

live dashboard acceptance

managed restart and HTTP 200 verification

Report:

root cause and existing zoning capability found

architecture implemented

files changed

schema and migration changes

Operator collectors and adapters added

Analyst inputs and outputs

evidence and artifact retention

tests added

full verification results

live acceptance property and official sources used

browser cleanup proof

known limitations

LandOS PID and URL

git status

Do not commit or push.
